name: NamedSlideShow
description: Represents a custom slide show, which is a named subset of slides in a presentation.
remarks: The NamedSlideShow object is a member of the NamedSlideShows collection. The NamedSlideShows collection contains all the named slide shows in the presentation.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: You cannot use this property to set the name for a custom slide show. Use the Add method to redefine a custom slide show under a new name. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideIDs
properties.description: Returns an array of slide IDs for the specified named slide show. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.
